question: Where did President Ram Nath Kovind inaugurate the Festival of Innovation & Entrepreneurship (FINE) on 15 March 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhinagar, Gujarat**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Festival of Innovation & Entrepreneurship (FINE) is organized to celebrate and promote innovation and entrepreneurship among young minds in India.
 
• The event serves as a platform for innovators to showcase their work and engage with potential investors and mentors.
 
• The inaugural event took place at the **Raj Bhavan** in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, highlighting the state's role in fostering innovation and entrepreneurship in the country.
 
• The festival included various activities, such as exhibitions, workshops, and discussions focused on promoting innovation across different sectors.
